units.title: Learning About Animals
steps: Look at a picture of a parrot. Notice its green feathers and red beak.
Learn that parrots are birds that can sometimes mimic sounds.
Understand that in stories, animals can talk and act like humans.

units.title: Understanding 'Wise'
units.description: Learning what it means to be smart and clever.
steps: Think of a time you solved a tricky puzzle.
Explain that being 'wise' means using what you know to solve problems.
Identify characters in other stories who were clever (like the thirsty crow).
